title: M5 stage20: exact quotient subset arithmetic n(P,W,k,z)
scope: Arithmetic character/binomial sum divided in ℤ equals exact quotient-residue k-subset count; monicity alone. Stage14 count and exact dependency closure imported with verified receipts.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.character_sign
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z = 1 ∨ M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z = -1
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
spec.guidance: Unfold quotient value and binary character. Each bitSign is a power of -1, hence their product is ±1. Preserve dimension zero and its empty product. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.coordinates_support_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (U : Finset ℕ), M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates P hP (AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U)) = M5.SubsetCharacter.vectorSum U (fun s => M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates P hP (AdjoinRoot.mk P ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ s)))
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
spec.guidance: Unfold ofSupport and vectorSum; use quotient algebra map and linear equivalence map_sum. Quotient collisions and all binary cancellations remain valid. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.binomial_coefficient
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree), M5.ArithmeticSubset.binomialTerm P hP W k lam = (M5.SubsetCharacter.signedProduct W (M5.ArithmeticSubset.monomialValue P hP lam)).coeff k
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
spec.guidance: Use accepted M5.Binomial.signed_coefficient_eval with character_sign. The two signedProduct definitions are identical. Symmetrize coefficient formula. Preserve all k including k>W.card. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.numerator_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.ArithmeticSubset.numerator P hP W k z = (2 : ℤ) ^ P.natDegree * (((W.powersetCard k).filter (fun U => AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U) = z)).card : ℤ)
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
spec.guidance: Use receipt-verified accepted stage14 subset_character_count from imported M5SubsetCountAccepted. Instantiate D=P.natDegree, f(s)=coordinates(mk P (X^s)), target coordinates(z). Rewrite binomial_coefficient. coordinates_support_sum and coordinates.injective identify the filter predicates. Reuse the imported accepted theorem. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.n_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.ArithmeticSubset.n P hP W k z = (((W.powersetCard k).filter (fun U => AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U) = z)).card : ℤ)
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
spec.guidance: Unfold n, rewrite numerator_exact, cancel integer division by the positive (2:ℤ)^P.natDegree. Preserve P=1, empty W, k=0 and k>W.card. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticSubset.n_nonnegative
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (z : AdjoinRoot P), 0 ≤ M5.ArithmeticSubset.n P hP W k z
queries: finite character sum subset polynomial coefficient
spec.guidance: Rewrite n_exact; natural-number cardinality cast to integer is nonnegative. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.
